headline: Habitats are homes—the environments that provide what species need to survive
universal_truth: Environment matters enormously; the right habitat enables thriving, the wrong one causes struggle
fun_facts: Polar bears can only survive in arctic habitats—they'd overheat and starve anywhere else
Habitat loss is the leading cause of species extinction worldwide
Some species have incredibly specific habitats—certain orchids need exactly one pollinator species
discussion_questions: What environments do you thrive in?
Are you in the right 'habitat' for your nature?
What would your ideal environment provide?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: A fish needs water. A cactus needs desert. A polar bear needs ice. Every species has a habitat—an environment providing food, shelter, mates, and conditions for survival. Without the right habitat, even the strongest organism fails.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Species are matched to habitats. Move them to wrong environments and they struggle or die. What does this teach about environment's role?

options.text: Habitat is often more important than individual ability—the right environment provides what you need; the wrong one creates constant struggle no matter how capable you are
options.response: Yes. A brilliant fish in a desert is still dead. Environment provides or denies the resources for success. Finding the right habitat can matter more than improving yourself.
Generalists have flexibility, but even they have limits—and most species are specialists...

q1.title: Specific Requirements
q1.script: Habitats provide specific resources: food, water, shelter, temperature, mates. Species evolve to need what their habitat offers. Move them, and they lack essentials.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Specific Requirements"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Habitat Loss
q2.script: When habitats shrink, species decline. It's not that animals get weaker—their homes disappear. Habitat destruction is the leading cause of extinction. Environment loss kills.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Your Habitat
q3.script: You have habitat requirements too. Some environments energize you; others drain you. Some provide what you need; others lack essentials. Finding your right habitat is strategic.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Environment matters enormously. The right habitat enables thriving; the wrong one causes struggle. Choose your environment wisely.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 269. Tomorrow, we'll explore stuff in the wrong place—pollution. Until then, assess whether your current environment fits your needs.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Habitat Assessment - Does Your Environment Fit?
growTrack.learning_objective: Evaluate environment fit for personal thriving
growTrack.activity: What does your ideal 'habitat' look like—work environment, living situation, social context? Does your current environment provide what you need? If not, can you change it or should you find a new one? Habitat selection is strategic.
